name: @cobuilders/safenet-mcp

tools.name: status
tools.description: Network totals on Ethereum Mainnet: stake, validators, pending withdrawals, rewards and the Merkle root, each with its source.

tools.name: validators_list
tools.description: Every validator SEF lists, with stake and registration from the chain and participation, commission and active from SEF. Participation is null when SEF publishes no rate, never 0.

active.description: Only validators SEF marks active (the default)

sort.description: Sort by stake or participation, highest first

tools.name: validators_show
tools.description: One validator, with its delegators count. The count needs an archive RPC endpoint; without one it is marked unavailable. Participation is null when SEF publishes no rate, never 0.

tools.name: withdrawals_list
tools.description: Pending withdrawals: the network total and count, or one staker's queue when address is given. The network count needs an archive RPC endpoint.

tools.name: rewards_check
tools.description: An address's rewards: earned, claimed, claimable and held amounts, and whether SEF's proof matches the root on chain.

tools.name: rewards_history
tools.description: An address's reward claims, newest first, the newest 20 unless all is true. Needs an archive RPC endpoint.

all.description: Every claim, not only the newest 20

tools.name: stake
tools.description: Stake SAFE on a validator, approving the staking contract first when the allowance is short. This server runs dry runs only: dryRun is forced to true, nothing is signed, and from is required.

amount.description: SAFE to stake, such as 100 or 0.5

approve.description: When the SAFE allowance is below the amount: approve exactly the amount, or an unlimited amount

dryRun.description: Read, simulate and estimate every transaction, and return what would be sent; nothing is signed. Forced to true unless the server was started with writes allowed and a signer.

from.description: The address a dry run simulates from. Required when the server has no signer; when it has one, it must be the signer's address

tools.name: unstake
tools.description: Start a withdrawal of SAFE staked on a validator. It becomes claimable after the delay. This server runs dry runs only: dryRun is forced to true, nothing is signed, and from is required.

amount.description: SAFE to withdraw, such as 100 or 0.5

dryRun.description: Read, simulate and estimate every transaction, and return what would be sent; nothing is signed. Forced to true unless the server was started with writes allowed and a signer.

from.description: The address a dry run simulates from. Required when the server has no signer; when it has one, it must be the signer's address

tools.name: withdrawals_claim
tools.description: Claim withdrawals past their delay. claimWithdrawal() pays the oldest first, so an id claims every one up to it. This server runs dry runs only: dryRun is forced to true, nothing is signed, and from is required.

id.description: Claim up to and including this withdrawal

all.description: Claim every withdrawal past its delay

dryRun.description: Read, simulate and estimate every transaction, and return what would be sent; nothing is signed. Forced to true unless the server was started with writes allowed and a signer.

from.description: The address a dry run simulates from. Required when the server has no signer; when it has one, it must be the signer's address

tools.name: rewards_claim
tools.description: Claim the signer's rewards with SEF's published proof, while its root is the root on chain. This server runs dry runs only: dryRun is forced to true, nothing is signed, and from is required.

dryRun.description: Read, simulate and estimate every transaction, and return what would be sent; nothing is signed. Forced to true unless the server was started with writes allowed and a signer.

from.description: The address a dry run simulates from. Required when the server has no signer; when it has one, it must be the signer's address

tools.name: rewards_claim_and_stake
tools.description: Claim the signer's rewards, then approve and stake what arrived on a validator, one transaction after another. This server runs dry runs only: dryRun is forced to true, nothing is signed, and from is required.

amount.description: Stake this much SAFE and leave the rest in the wallet; more than the claimable amount is refused before anything is sent

approve.description: When the SAFE allowance is below the amount: approve exactly the amount, or an unlimited amount

dryRun.description: Read, simulate and estimate every transaction, and return what would be sent; nothing is signed. Forced to true unless the server was started with writes allowed and a signer.

from.description: The address a dry run simulates from. Required when the server has no signer; when it has one, it must be the signer's address

instructions: Reads Safenet staking on Ethereum Mainnet and the data SEF publishes. Every figure carries its source. Amounts are wei as decimal strings, with SAFE amounts as decimal strings next to them in write results. Writes are off: every write tool returns a dry run, simulated from the address in from, and signs nothing.
stderr:
safenet-mcp: RPC from the public list; writes off, every write is a dry run.
safenet-mcp: compliance gates on every write: the sanctions oracle; the sanctions endpoint not set; the geo check off.
